name: hw-xscreenshot
title: X Post Screenshot
description: Turn the X (Twitter) post in your active browser tab into a clean screenshot image on your clipboard.
author: martin_mikusat

commands.name: screenshot-x-post
commands.title: Screenshot X Post
commands.description: Render the X post in the active browser tab as an image and copy it to the clipboard

commands.name: open-screenshot-folder
commands.title: Open X Screenshot Folder
commands.description: Open the folder holding your saved X post screenshots

preferences.name: theme
preferences.title: Theme
preferences.description: Colors of the rendered post card

preferences.name: closeOnSuccess
preferences.label: Close the launcher when the screenshot is done
preferences.title: After Capture
preferences.description: Off keeps Raycast open and shows a result toast with a Show in Finder action

preferences.name: saveFolder
preferences.title: Save Folder
preferences.description: Where screenshots are saved as PNG; empty uses Pictures/hw_raycast_xscreenshot
